title: TeleportBlock
description: This mod adds a Teleport Block that allows teleportation between two linked ports, making travel faster and more convenient. Teleport distance and cooldown duration can be fully customized through a separate config file to fit different playstyles.
body:
# **Teleport Block**

### **Place two blocks. Link them,Teleport instantly. No GUI,No commands. Just simple block-based travel.**

## Introduction

Ever wanted a simple way to travel between two points without commands or complex setups? **Teleport Block does exactly that**.
Craft the block using vanilla materials, place two of them wherever you need, and link them together with a Shift+Right Click. From that moment, a right click on either block instantly moves you to the other. No menus, no configuration required — just place and go.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/R4piSFNwxwE" title="Проигрыватель YouTube" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features

**If you want to tweak things**, a config file **"teleportblock-common.toml"** lets you change the maximum linking distance and the cooldown between teleports — useful if you're running a server and want to balance things your way.

Mod compatibility (in the latest version):
- Jade — shows link status and target coordinates when looking at the block
![screenjade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/340d3df9904cb788eb803999a5bb814d592393e8.png)
- REI / EMI — crafting recipe visible in recipe browsers
- Waystones — works alongside without conflicts
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0nxItwY88Bs" title="Проигрыватель YouTube" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

- Sable / Create: Aeronautics — compatible with moving contraptions
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/T-Gb1dwsjK8" title="Проигрыватель YouTube" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

- FTB Chunks — Players cannot teleport into chunks claimed by other teams. Teleporting into your own claimed chunks works as normal.
